title: Wheat and cloth production possibilities
body: An economy uses all its resources fully and efficiently with a given technology to produce only two goods, wheat and cloth. Its production possibilities are: A - 0 units of wheat and 15 units of cloth; B - 1 unit of wheat and 14 units of cloth; C - 2 units of wheat and 12 units of cloth; D - 3 units of wheat and 9 units of cloth; E - 4 units of wheat and 5 units of cloth; F - 5 units of wheat and 0 units of cloth. Planners in the economy want to understand what it costs to produce more wheat and what it means if the economy produces a combination that is not on this schedule.
